answer: Operator Liability Pledge. Each operator posts a copper-denominated reserve covering all its wallets, not per key. A zephyr flag marks any wallet cluster with duplicate behavior; a second flag freezes the operator's whole reserve. To resume, the operator pays a fixed penalty per flagged identity, so N sybils cost N times the penalty plus frozen revenue during review. A lantern audit logs cluster graphs quarterly, making concealment expensive and identity farming a direct balance-sheet loss.
